title: OPEX-guided experiments reveal bacterial cross-stress responses
summary: Learned models selected bacterial stress-combination experiments and incorporated their measurements. The study reported cross-stress protection and vulnerability patterns, with follow-up supporting roles for stress-response machinery. This is a laboratory microbiology result, not a clinical resistance prediction or evidence of treatment efficacy.

evidence.tested: Selected experiments and subsequent biological validation tested stress responses.
evidence.unknown: Transfer beyond the studied organism and conditions, clinical outcomes and independent replication were not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: OPEX machine-learning experimental selection supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.

source_review.scope: Primary PubMed abstract/date/affiliations, indexed deposited publisher-paper abstract and author laboratory announcement.
